description: Leakage-aware, domain-specific AtomR demonstrations derived from non-target facts in the entertainment tables and linked documents.

stage_guidance.tree_generation: Decompose entertainment questions into a table bridge lookup followed by a linked-document fact lookup when needed. Keep every child executable and preserve [n] references exactly.
stage_guidance.source_selection: Table means the complete table bound to this question. Text means documents linked from that table. Use Table for rows, ranks, dates, names, genres, studios, or candidates; use Text for biography, plot, translation, creator, history, and other narrative facts; use both for bridge questions.
stage_guidance.direct_answer: Return only evidence-compatible entertainment entities, titles, dates, counts, people, organizations, or short phrases in the required Answer List format.
stage_guidance.direct_rag: Treat the bound table as the candidate or bridge source and linked documents as narrative evidence. Resolve the bridge explicitly, copy the final answer span faithfully, and never replace supplied evidence with unrelated prior knowledge.
stage_guidance.search: Search identifies the entity or candidate requested by the current sub-question. Prefer the exact table cell or linked-document title and do not jump ahead to the final multi-hop answer.
stage_guidance.relate: Relate returns only the value connected to the given entity by the requested relation. Preserve exact names, dates, counts, translations, titles, and award results from evidence.
stage_guidance.filter: Filter applies every stated condition to the supplied candidate set. Compare rows carefully and return all and only matching entities.
stage_guidance.answer_from_child_qa: Fuse child answers in dependency order. Use bridge answers to resolve references, discard intermediate entities from the final list unless explicitly requested, and return Unknown if the children do not support a final answer.
